# powerdns_zones (Data Source)

Every zone on the server.

The list endpoint omits records, so this is cheap even on a server holding thousands of zones. Reading one zone's records needs `powerdns_zone` and `powerdns_record`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every zone on the server. The list endpoint omits records, so this stays
# cheap even on a server holding thousands.
data "powerdns_zones" "all" {}

output "slave_zones" {
  value = [for z in data.powerdns_zones.all.zones : z.name if z.kind == "Slave"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Fixed: this data source reads the whole server.
- `names` (List of String) Zone names, for the common case of iterating them.
- `zones` (Attributes List) Each zone with its kind and serial. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `serial` (Number)
